name: Ibrahim Traoré
role: Interim president of Burkina Faso and head of the military junta (2022–present)
summary: Military officer who took power in a coup in September 2022 and styles his rule a popular progressive revolution in the tradition of Thomas Sankara. He is anti-imperialist and pan-Africanist, openly rejects democracy and party politics as unsuited to his country, and pursues state control of gold mining, self-reliance and alignment with Russia and the Sahel confederation.

notes: Leads a military junta: only his own words and measures he drove are used; statements by ministers and joint AES communiqués are low confidence or null. In April 2025 he said democracy is only the end point of a revolution; by April 2026 he said democracy is not for Burkina Faso. Several answers rest on his government record rather than direct statements.

markets-allocate-better.rationale: Pursued nationalisation and state exploitation of gold and rejected past partnership models with multinationals; no explicit statement on markets.

public-ownership.rationale: Took state control of gold mines via the state miner SOPAMIB and says he will continue; energy, rail and utilities not addressed.

strong-leader.rationale: Rejects pluralist democracy in favour of revolutionary order and discipline under his leadership; has not stated this in terms of gridlock.

state-harmful.rationale: Describes his programme as a "rebuilding of the state" and expands state economic role.

empower-police-military.rationale: Announced "we will set up a strong army", launched mass recruitment of VDP volunteers and introduced taxes to fund the military.

gradual-change.rationale: Said "the revolution is a rupture" and that he would not follow a set direction; wants revolution in mentality and industry rather than step-by-step change.

expand-nuclear.rationale: Asked Putin for a small nuclear power plant to generate electricity for Burkina Faso and the subregion.

revolution-justified.rationale: Declared the country in a "popular progressive revolution", saying all peoples passed through revolution and that a real revolution is needed; came to power through a coup.

state-directs-investment.rationale: Government under him built state-backed gold refinery and processing plants and launched a state-led 2026-2030 plan.

democracy-best.rationale: Said on state TV (Apr 2026) that democracy "kills", is "not for us" and is "slavery"; asked that people forget it. Earlier (Apr 2025): no country developed through democracy, it is only the end point.

political-violence-never.rationale: Led the Sept 2022 coup and endorses revolution and a "total war" on jihadists; treats armed struggle as legitimate.

direct-action.rationale: Says change comes by revolution, with democracy only the end result, rather than through elections and parliaments.

conscription.rationale: Declared a general mobilisation in April 2023 allowing requisition of civilians over 18 for the war effort; no statement on conscription in general.

dominated-front.rationale: Played a major role founding the Alliance of Sahel States, an anti-neocolonial grouping, and calls African leaders to stop acting as imperialism's puppets.

political-elite-corrupt.rationale: Said a "real politician" in Burkina embodies every vice: liar, sycophant, smooth-talker; earlier said politicians handed out suitcases of money while soldiers lacked equipment.

night-watchman-state.rationale: Expanded the state into gold mining and agriculture and wants a state-led revolution.

emergency-suspend-protections.rationale: No recorded position on this statement: calls to treat traitors without mercy and a general mobilisation are nearby, not a stated view on suspending legal protections.

pool-sovereignty.rationale: AES confederation he co-founded and now chairs aims at pooling resources and eventual federation; he left ECOWAS, so the stance is on specific unions.

restrict-freedoms-for-growth.rationale: Argued (Apr 2025, Apr 2026) that development needs revolution, order and discipline first and that "libertinage" of action or expression has no place; democracy is only the outcome.

collective-defense.rationale: AES began as a mutual defense pact among Burkina Faso, Mali and Niger, which he helped found.

armed-group-creates-revolution.rationale: A small military group (Sept 2022 coup) took power and he then proclaimed a revolution; he has not stated it as a general principle.

civilizing-tutelage.rationale: Describes neocolonialism and imperialism as slavery that Africa must reject.

self-reliance-over-aid.rationale: Criticised African leaders who "beg", urged food self-sufficiency and stressed economic self-reliance; but also seeks Russian investment and keeps IMF links.

institutions-fit-civilization.rationale: Said "we have our own model" and that democracy as shown by the West is not for Africans; each people should find its own system.

non-intervention.rationale: Called for "a free world without interference in our internal affairs" and condemned Western interference; has not discussed intervention "for any reason".

local-production.rationale: Ordered army rations from locally processed products instead of imports and pursues food self-sufficiency.

criminalize-homosexuality.rationale: No recorded position on this statement: he signed the Family Code provision, but no statement of his own was found; a signature alone is not his position.

suppress-opposition.rationale: Dissolved all political parties (Jan 2026) as divisive and dangerous, said freedom of expression understood as "libertinage" has no place, and vowed to be pitiless to alleged traitors. Reported crackdown on critics is by the government, so medium.

colonies-serve-metropole.rationale: Denounces colonial and neocolonial extraction of Africa's wealth.

abolish-armed-forces.rationale: Pledged to build a strong army, expanded the VDP volunteer force and created taxes to fund the military.

never-kill-self-defence.rationale: Called armed volunteers who take up arms against terrorists patriots and defended their right to defend themselves; leads the armed campaign.

international-criminal-courts.rationale: AES states, including his government, announced withdrawal from the ICC as a "neo-colonial imperialist tool" while planning a Sahel criminal court. Statement was joint, not personal.

bypass-parties-groups.rationale: Called parties divisive, dangerous and incompatible with the revolution and dissolved them; spoke of grassroots and traditional structures in their place.

national-resource-control.rationale: Said "our approach is to exploit our gold ourselves" and took over foreign-run mines, adding state stakes.

multipolar-world.rationale: Told Putin: "We want a multipolar world, and we stand for sovereignty."
